evidence: For thALD Ru seed layer deposition at 250 °C we examined the heteroleptic precursor ECPR [(ethylcyclopentadienyl)(pyrrolyl)ruthenium(II)], a complex compound from Praxair Technology, Inc. [ 19]. ECPR oﬀered a relatively high vapor pressure of 20 Pa at the set bubbler temperature of 80 °C as well as a high thermal stability (decomposition temperature above 350 °C). A twofold argon carrier gas ﬂow of 100 sccm for 30 s was used to improve the precursor delivery into the reaction chamber; and a subsequent pure argon gas ﬂow of 2.000 sccm for 30 s purged the reactor after the respective ALD half-reactions. Molecular oxygen with a gas ﬂow of 200 sccm for 10 s provided the second reactant source with an argon gas ﬂow of 2.000 sccm for 30 s. Additional purge steps with hydrogen (200 sccm for 60 s) and argon (2.000 sccm for 30 s) after every third ALD cycle ( Fig. 1b) prevent blister formation, improve the layer adhesion and guarantee good layer properties.
